description: This hike begins on an old road and then climbs through forested and sub-alpine areas towards Slatechuck Mountain. This is a wilderness trail with steep terrain. Be prepared for changing conditions.
directions: From the western end of Oceanview Drive in the Village of Daajing Giids, travel along the Honna FSR to the 5km road marker and then turn onto the Sleeping Beauty FSR. Travel 3.6km to the trail head signs located at the junction with the old road that forms the first stage of the trail. Trail head location -132 11.65913 53 15.421952
title: Slatechuck Trail
